The '''Fondor Five''' was a criminal organization part of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] and was active in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==History==
Formed by five various alien criminals, the Fondor Five were vicious murderers known throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the gang traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where a sizable bounty was placed on their heads in hopes that the criminals could be brought to justice. They were eventually killed in a firefight in the [[Fartrader Lounge]]<ref name="TOR" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR_dates" />
